items.title: Tarikh al-Sudan
date: The matched work article dates composition to around 1655. Later manuscript copies, the 1898 printed Arabic edition and later translations are not the original work date.
items.description: A chronicle of Songhai, Timbuktu and Djenné, combining political history with accounts of scholars and religious life. Written after the Songhai Empire, it preserves an influential account of its past.
items.basis: Editorial selection for West African trade and learning: a Timbuktu chronicle of the Songhai Empire, written in Arabic.
items.identityReview: Original chronicle Q13217999; not a surviving manuscript or French/English translation. No modern country inferred.
